llm_response.reason: The website impersonates a well-known brand (Quiksilver) but uses an unrelated domain name ('Libby Weber'). There is no evidence of legitimate company or business information, contact details are missing, and hyperlinks do not reveal any proper legal or customer support sections. The site uses urgency tactics like 'Gran venta' (Big sale) and claims secure payment and free shipping, but does not provide verifiable connection to Quiksilver. These match typical characteristics of Fake Online Shopping scam websites.
